items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And Louis Taylor, George Ohrendorf, Lawrence Brown and Lionel. Who was on the tuba? [INTERVIEWEE] Tuba Jack. Tuba Jack.

ctx.x: Yeah, I remember that. so they got him out and brought him back to the city and that's when Lionel joined Paul's band.
(inaudible) And Louis Taylor, do you know him?
No. Is that the trombone player?
